$description: Design tokens for the ACG design system, mapped from base.css, colors.css, and typography.css following the W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (2025.10).

spacing.$description: Spacing scale used for margins, paddings, gaps, and layout offsets.

0.$description: Zero spacing. Used to reset or collapse spacing.

1.$description: Extra-small spacing (4px). Tight padding and small gaps.

2.$description: Small spacing (8px). Common inline gap and icon padding.

3.$description: Medium-small spacing (12px). Used for compact component padding.

4.$description: Medium spacing (16px). Base unit; standard component padding.

5.$description: Medium spacing (20px). Button padding and card insets.

6.$description: Medium-large spacing (24px). Section padding and form gaps.

8.$description: Large spacing (32px). Card padding and content block gaps.

24.$description: 5xl spacing (96px). Hero sections and large gaps.

96.$description: 13xl spacing (384px). Maximum spacing value in the scale.

borderRadius.$description: Border radius scale for rounding element corners.

none.$description: No border radius. Sharp, squared corners.

xs.$description: Extra-small border radius (1px). Barely rounded corners.

sm.$description: Small border radius (2px). Subtle rounding for inputs and badges.

default.$description: Default border radius (4px). Standard rounding for buttons and cards.

md.$description: Medium border radius (6px). Slightly more pronounced rounding.

lg.$description: Large border radius (8px). Card and modal rounding.

xl.$description: Extra-large border radius (12px). Prominent rounding for panels.

2xl.$description: 2xl border radius (16px). Heavily rounded panels and dialogs.

full.$description: Fully rounded. Creates circles from square elements and pill shapes from rectangles.

shadow.$description: Box shadow elevation scale for depth and layering effects.

xs.$description: Extra-small shadow. Subtle lift for flat elements like inputs.

sm.$description: Small shadow. Light elevation for cards and buttons at rest.

default.$description: Default shadow. Standard elevation for interactive components.

md.$description: Medium shadow. Moderate elevation for dropdowns and hover states.

lg.$description: Large shadow. Strong elevation for modals and popovers.

xl.$description: Extra-large shadow. High elevation for dialogs and overlays.

2xl.$description: 2xl shadow. Maximum elevation for toast notifications and critical overlays.

inner.$description: Inner shadow. Inset shadow for pressed states and recessed surfaces.

none.$description: No shadow. Removes all box shadow effects.

duration.$description: Animation duration scale for transitions and motion.

75.$description: Ultra-fast duration. Used for micro-interactions like opacity toggles.

100.$description: Very fast duration. Hover state color transitions.

150.$description: Fast duration. Default for most UI state transitions.

200.$description: Medium-fast duration. Button presses and input focus rings.

300.$description: Medium duration. Standard transition for reveals and fades.

500.$description: Medium-slow duration. Panel slides and expansion animations.

700.$description: Slow duration. Complex entrance animations and page transitions.

1000.$description: Very slow duration. Full-page transitions and loading sequences.

easing.$description: Easing functions for animation curves and transition timing.

linear.$description: Linear easing. Constant speed with no acceleration or deceleration.

in.$description: Ease-in. Starts slow and accelerates. Use for elements exiting the viewport.

out.$description: Ease-out. Starts fast and decelerates. Use for elements entering the viewport.

in-out.$description: Ease-in-out. Slow start and end with acceleration in the middle. General purpose easing.

bounce.$description: Bounce easing. Overshoots the target and settles back. Use for playful attention-drawing animations.

zIndex.$description: Z-index layering scale to manage stacking order of elements.

0.$description: Base stacking level. Default layer for in-flow elements.

10.$description: Low elevation. Slightly elevated elements like sticky headers.

20.$description: Medium-low elevation. Dropdowns and positioned elements.

30.$description: Medium elevation. Fixed navigation and toolbars.

40.$description: Medium-high elevation. Modal backdrops and overlays.

50.$description: High elevation. Modal dialogs and critical overlays.

dropdown.$description: Dropdown menus. Ensures dropdowns float above standard content.

sticky.$description: Sticky elements. Keeps sticky headers above dropdowns.

fixed.$description: Fixed elements. Fixed navigation and sidebars.

modal-backdrop.$description: Modal backdrop layer. Overlay behind modal dialogs.

modal.$description: Modal dialogs. Primary overlay layer for dialogs and sheets.

popover.$description: Popovers and tooltips. Floats above modals when needed.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips. Highest standard UI layer for contextual hints.

toast.$description: Toast notifications. Topmost layer to ensure visibility of alerts.

breakpoint.$description: Responsive breakpoints for adaptive layout changes.

sm.$description: Small breakpoint. Targets large phones in landscape and small tablets.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint. Targets tablets in portrait orientation.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint. Targets tablets in landscape and small laptops.

xl.$description: Extra-large breakpoint. Targets standard desktop monitors.

2xl.$description: 2xl breakpoint. Targets large desktop monitors and wide displays.

container.$description: Maximum container widths for constraining content regions.

xs.$description: Extra-small container (320px). Narrow content like login forms.

md.$description: Medium container (448px). Dialogs and narrow forms.

xl.$description: Extra-large container (576px). Wide forms and panels.

prose.$description: Prose container. Optimal reading width for long-form text content.

aspectRatio.$description: Aspect ratio tokens for constraining element proportions.

auto.$description: Auto aspect ratio. Element determines its own proportions from content.

square.$description: Square aspect ratio (1:1). Profile images, avatars, and icons.

video.$description: Video aspect ratio (16:9). Standard widescreen video and hero images.

wide.$description: Wide aspect ratio (21:9). Cinematic banners and ultra-wide layouts.

color.$description: Semantic color tokens for the ACG design system light theme. Values in HSL.

background.$description: Default page background color. Pure white for light mode.

foreground.$description: Default text and icon color on the page background.

primary.$description: Primary brand color. Used for main CTAs, links, and active states.

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on primary-colored backgrounds.

secondary.$description: Secondary color. Used for less prominent actions and backgrounds.

secondary-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on secondary-colored backgrounds.

accent.$description: Accent color. Used for highlights, badges, and decorative elements.

accent-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on accent-colored backgrounds.

muted.$description: Muted background color. Used for disabled states and subtle surfaces.

muted-foreground.$description: Text color for muted or secondary content like placeholders and captions.

destructive.$description: Destructive action color. Used for delete buttons, error states, and danger alerts.

destructive-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on destructive-colored backgrounds.

success.$description: Success color. Used for confirmation states, valid inputs, and positive feedback.

success-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on success-colored backgrounds.

warning.$description: Warning color. Used for caution states, pending actions, and advisory alerts.

warning-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on warning-colored backgrounds.

info.$description: Informational color. Used for notices, help text, and informational banners.

info-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on info-colored backgrounds.

border.$description: Default border color. Used for dividers, input borders, and separators.

border-hover.$description: Border color on hover state. Slightly darker than the default border.

input.$description: Input border color at rest. Matches the default border color.

input-focus.$description: Input border color when focused. References the primary color for visual emphasis.

ring.$description: Focus ring color. Used for keyboard focus indicators. References the primary color.

ring-offset.$description: Focus ring offset color. Gap between the ring and the element. References the background color.

card.$description: Card background color. Surface color for card components.

card-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on card backgrounds.

popover.$description: Popover background color. Surface color for dropdowns, tooltips, and popovers.

popover-foreground.$description: Text and icon color on popover backgrounds.

surface.$description: Surface elevation colors. Progressively darker backgrounds for layered surfaces.

0.$description: Surface level 0. Base surface, equivalent to the page background.

1.$description: Surface level 1. Slightly elevated surface for sections and sidebars.

2.$description: Surface level 2. Mid-elevation surface for cards within sections.

3.$description: Surface level 3. High-elevation surface for nested cards and raised panels.

brand.$description: Brand palette scale from lightest (50) to darkest (950). Full color ramp for the primary brand hue.

50.$description: Brand 50. Lightest tint for subtle backgrounds and hover states.

100.$description: Brand 100. Very light tint for selected row backgrounds.

200.$description: Brand 200. Light tint for active backgrounds and focus rings.

300.$description: Brand 300. Mid-light tone for borders and decorative accents.

400.$description: Brand 400. Medium tone for secondary buttons and icons.

500.$description: Brand 500. Core brand color. Primary buttons and active links.

600.$description: Brand 600. Slightly darker brand color. Hover states for primary elements.

700.$description: Brand 700. Dark brand color. Active/pressed states.

800.$description: Brand 800. Very dark brand color for high-contrast text on light brand backgrounds.

900.$description: Brand 900. Near-black brand color for headings and bold text.

950.$description: Brand 950. Darkest brand shade. Used for dark-mode surfaces and high-contrast elements.

fontFamily.$description: Font family stacks for different typographic roles.

sans.$description: Sans-serif font stack. Default body text face using Inter with system fallbacks.

heading.$description: Heading font stack. Used for all headings and display text.

mono.$description: Monospace font stack. Used for code, pre-formatted text, and technical content.

serif.$description: Serif font stack. Used for editorial content, pull quotes, and decorative typography.

fontSize.$description: Type scale for font sizes from extra-small to 9xl display.

xs.$description: Extra-small font size (12px). Captions, footnotes, and legal text.

sm.$description: Small font size (14px). Helper text, labels, and secondary content.

base.$description: Base font size (16px). Default body text size.

lg.$description: Large font size (18px). Lead paragraphs and emphasized body text.

xl.$description: Extra-large font size (20px). Small headings and subheadings.

9xl.$description: 9xl font size (128px). Maximum display text for hero banners.

lineHeight.$description: Line height scale for controlling vertical rhythm and text readability.

none.$description: No extra line height. Text sits exactly at the font size. Use for single-line display text.

tight.$description: Tight line height. Used for large headings where compact spacing is desired.

snug.$description: Snug line height. Slightly more breathing room than tight; good for medium headings.

normal.$description: Normal line height. Default for body text ensuring comfortable readability.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed line height. Extra vertical space for dense paragraphs and small text.

loose.$description: Loose line height. Double-spaced text for maximum readability and annotations.

heading.$description: Heading line height. Optimized for large display and page headings.

subheading.$description: Subheading line height. Tuned for section subheadings and smaller heading levels.

fontWeight.$description: Font weight scale from thin (100) to black (900).

thin.$description: Thin weight (100). Decorative use only; avoid for small text or critical content.

extralight.$description: Extra-light weight (200). Large display text and stylistic headings.

light.$description: Light weight (300). Elegant body text on high-resolution displays.

normal.$description: Normal weight (400). Default body text weight.

medium.$description: Medium weight (500). Slightly emphasized text, labels, and navigation items.

semibold.$description: Semi-bold weight (600). Subheadings, button text, and strong labels.

bold.$description: Bold weight (700). Headings and key UI text that needs emphasis.

extrabold.$description: Extra-bold weight (800). High-impact headings and display text.

black.$description: Black weight (900). Maximum weight for hero text and bold branding.

letterSpacing.$description: Letter spacing (tracking) scale for adjusting character spacing.

tighter.$description: Tightest tracking. Large display headings where characters need to be closer.

tight.$description: Tight tracking. Headings and subheadings with subtle tightening.

normal.$description: Normal tracking. Default letter spacing for body text.

wide.$description: Wide tracking. Small text, labels, and uppercase text for readability.

wider.$description: Wider tracking. Uppercase labels, overlines, and eyebrow text.

widest.$description: Widest tracking. Fully spaced-out uppercase text for decorative use.

heading.$description: Heading tracking. Slightly tightened for heading hierarchy.

wordSpacing.$description: Word spacing tokens for controlling space between words.

tight.$description: Tight word spacing. Reduces space between words for dense layouts.

normal.$description: Normal word spacing. Browser default spacing between words.

wide.$description: Wide word spacing. Increases readability in short uppercase strings.

textDecoration.$description: Text decoration tokens for underline thickness and offset.

thickness-auto.$description: Automatic underline thickness determined by the browser and font metrics.

thickness-from-font.$description: Underline thickness derived from font metadata for consistent rendering.

thickness-1.$description: 1px underline thickness. Thin, subtle underlines for links.

thickness-2.$description: 2px underline thickness. Standard underlines for emphasis.

offset-auto.$description: Automatic underline offset. Positioned by the browser for optimal descender clearance.

offset-1.$description: 1px underline offset from the text baseline.

offset-2.$description: 2px underline offset. Slightly further from the baseline.

offset-4.$description: 4px underline offset. Notable gap between text and underline for stylistic use.

offset-8.$description: 8px underline offset. Large gap for decorative underline treatments.

paragraph.$description: Paragraph formatting tokens for text blocks and long-form content.

none.$description: No paragraph indent. Default for web content.

sm.$description: Small paragraph indent (16px). Subtle first-line indentation.

md.$description: Medium paragraph indent (24px). Standard book-style indentation.

lg.$description: Large paragraph indent (32px). Prominent indentation for formal text.

none.$description: No paragraph spacing. Paragraphs flow without extra vertical gap.

sm.$description: Small paragraph spacing (12px). Compact paragraph separation.

md.$description: Medium paragraph spacing (16px). Standard gap between paragraphs.

lg.$description: Large paragraph spacing (24px). Generous separation for readability.

prose.$description: Prose content width tokens for optimal reading line lengths.

xs.$description: Extra-small prose width. Narrow column for sidebars and annotations.

sm.$description: Small prose width. Compact reading column.

default.$description: Default prose width. Optimal reading length for body text (65 characters).

lg.$description: Large prose width. Wider column for technical documentation.

xl.$description: Extra-large prose width. Wide column for code-heavy content.
